# List Convex deployment regions (`list_convex_deployment_regions`)

MCP tool `convex_listDeploymentRegions` · scope `access_provider_connections` · read_only

Lists the production deployment regions currently available to the selected organization's connected
Convex team. The result also returns the organization's saved default, or null when no default is
saved. Availability is live Convex data. The saved default only starts a new project form. Selecting
another region for one project does not change it. This action does not modify Samebase or Convex.

## Arguments

- `githubOwnerLogin` (string, required): GitHub owner login for the Samebase organization.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "defaultRegion": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "const": "aws-us-east-1"
            },
            {
              "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "regions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "const": "aws-us-east-1"
              },
              {
                "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
              }
            ]
          },
          "displayName": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "available": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": ["name", "displayName", "available"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["defaultRegion", "regions"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
